API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS)NSS Resource Get NSS Server
NSS Resource Get NSS Server
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssServers/:nssId

Retrieves the registered NSS server based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
nssId
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the NSS ID

Responses
​
200
401
404
500

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated identifier of the NSS server based on the software platform

name
string

NSS server name

status
string

Enables or disables the status of the NSS server

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED, DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_PROVIDER, NOT_PROVISIONED_IN_SERVICE_PROVIDER, IN_TRIAL]

state
string

The health of the NSS server

Possible values: [UNHEALTHY, HEALTHY, UNKNOWN]

icapSvrId
int32

The ICAP server ID
